items.title: Announcing Cloudflare Wallets: the programmable wallet for the agentic Internet
items.summary: Today, it is difficult for AI agents to try out new APIs. They often have to navigate through a login page designed for humans and not agents, contact a human to add a payment method, generate an API key, and then figure out how to call the API. This flow is very difficult for agents for two reasons: Agents do not have a stable identifier to sign up for an API, and they do not have a native way to pay for APIs. Becau
items.summaryZh: Cloudflare推出了“智能体钱包”（Cloudflare Wallets），旨在为AI智能体提供稳定的身份标识和自主支付能力。该方案支持x402协议，允许智能体通过虚拟钱包安全地购买API服务、工具及内容。通过设置交易限额和白名单等防护机制，该系统为构建“智能体经济”提供了关键的支付与合规基础设施。

items.title: How Cloudflare enforces engineering standards using AI
items.summary: Over the past four months, our AI code reviewer has flagged nearly a quarter of a million deviations from Cloudflare engineering standards (what we’ll call “violations” in this post) and blocked 16,000 merges. Our spec reviewer agent has evaluated close to 600 technical designs against the same standards before implementation began. Both systems draw from the Cloudflare Codex, a shared source of engineering guidance
